WITH tre AS (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE city = 'Tampere' AND store_id < 900 AND is_current),
cur AS (SELECT member_id, home_store_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current),
asof AS (SELECT member_id, home_store_id FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2026-10-04' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to),
act_all AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'),
act_clean AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test')
SELECT 'registered_current_home_tampere' AS k, count(DISTINCT member_id) n FROM cur WHERE home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tre)
UNION ALL SELECT 'registered_asof_home_tampere', count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM asof WHERE home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tre)

UNION ALL SELECT 'active_clean_home_tampere_current', count(DISTINCT a.member_id) FROM act_clean a JOIN cur o USING(member_id) WHERE o.home_store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM tre)
UNION ALL SELECT 'asof_rows_dupe_check', count(*) - count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM asof
